title: Chinna Thambi
desc: After an astrologer predicts that their sister will marry a man of her own choosing, three protective brothers go to dire lengths to prevent the prophecy from being fulfilled.

title: Ananda Ragam
desc: A fisherman arranges to wed his sister to a wealthy man, despite having knowledge of her love affair with another man. He later discovers her husband's chronic illness, but it's too late.

title: Mamiyargal Jakkirathai
desc: Selvi, a young educated girl, gets ill-treated at her husband's house in the name of dowry. Later, she decides to set her mother-in-law straight.

title: Aasai Thambi
desc: Vinoth's world turns upside down when his younger brother gets caught in a dangerous web of crime, forcing him to confront powerful enemies and make life-altering choices.

title: Captain Prabhakar
desc: Prabhakaran, a forest officer, is assigned to arrest the notorious smuggler Veerabhadran. While duty calls, Parabhakaran also decides to avenge his friend's death.
